Initial release — brings CellCog-powered content creation for Instagram and TikTok.

- Generate Reels, Stories, posts, carousels, and short-form videos using flexible prompts.
- Access AI-driven content styles: trending, educational, behind-the-scenes, inspirational, infographics, and more.
- Supports both Instagram and TikTok-specific post and video formats with up-to-date spec guidance.
- Agent-based chat modes for single content or multi-part campaign series.
- Includes detailed prompt patterns, content style options, and best practices for viral social media content.
